name: Say Hello Simple
description: Simple template that prints hello world message

task_steps.description: Print a greeting message using the provided name and message variables. Format: Hello {name}! {message}

prompt.template:
Print a greeting message to the user.

Format the message as: "Hello {{name}}! {{message}}"

Output the greeting directly - no files need to be created, just print the message.

The greeting should be friendly and match the format exactly.

variables.name: name
variables.description: Name to include in the greeting

variables.name: message
variables.description: The message to print after the greeting

task_steps.description: Confirm that the greeting was displayed successfully and report completion

prompt.template:
Review the output from the previous task and confirm that:

1. The greeting message was displayed
2. The message contains "Hello"
3. The message includes the name that was provided
4. No error messages appeared

If all checks pass, report: "✅ Greeting displayed successfully!"

If any check fails, report which validation failed.
